rubric.evidence: Every frame except the title card, versus panel and end card keeps the same two lanes (rate, CPI) and event lane; only the time-axis ticks change. The versus panel is also overlaid on the dimmed stage.
The camera moves along one time axis from the 2026.09 pin → 2025.10 → 2026.02–07 → 2026.09 → the full overview. There is no new canvas.
The right axis runs from 0% to 5.5%/0.98%, and every lane has a '%' unit and a source line such as 'FRED … 2026년 8월 기준'. The corner date is always shown.
Card values match the subtitles: 0.25%p, 12대 0, 3.75~4%, 약 3.6%, 16만 2천 명, 약 630포인트, 약 5%, 3.7%.
The 2026 hold period in p_0091.71–p_0138.33 appears only as a blue line (the cut colour). No grey hold segment or target-range band is visible.
In p_0249.41, the dot plot gets a one-sentence definition subtitle when it first comes up. The 'SEP' pin label is a minor gap (soft).
No subtitle or card reads as a buy/sell recommendation; the close is only 'not yet decided'.
